body.zh: 新华、人民日报仍为9月5日18时指挥部：43死、519失联、2人获救。外交部9月24日仍称261名外籍失联，未替代分项。尼方仍用NDRRMA约9月26日：1453死、5285失联、13795获救。SitRep#25为最新专报。堰塞湖已排空。G216仅救援。口岸关闭。勿与中方相加。
body.en: Xinhua/People's Daily still command-centre as of 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. MFA 24 Sep still 261 foreign missing, not a new split. NP still NDRRMA around 26 Sep: 1453 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. SitRep#25 is latest dedicated report. Lake drained. G216 SAR-only. Gate closed. Do not add CN.
body.ne: CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MFA 261 foreign missing. NP NDRRMA ~26 Sep: 1453/5285/13795. SitRep#25 antim. Tal khali. G216 uddhar matra. Gate band. CN najodnu.
body.hi: CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MFA 261 videshi missing. NP NDRRMA ~26 Sep: 1453/5285/13795. SitRep#25 antim. Jheel khali. G216 kewal SAR. Gate band. CN na joden.

body.zh: 分县遗体统计已发；1334具已处置。未公布获救总数。安置1283人。COP主KPI仍用NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795。勿与中方相加。
body.en: District body counts posted; 1334 bodies managed. No rescued total. 1283 in shelters. COP main KPI remains NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795. Do not add CN.
body.ne: Jilla hisab; 1334 deha. Rescued total chaina. 1283 shelter. COP KPI NDRRMA. CN najodnu.
body.hi: Zila hisab; 1334 deh. Rescued total nahi. 1283 shelter. COP KPI NDRRMA. CN na joden.

body.zh: 1453死、5285失联；21个安置点约1109人（Rasuwa 805）。25–28日强降雨专报未列Rasuwa新伤亡。
body.en: 1453 dead, 5285 missing; about 1109 in 21 centres (805 Rasuwa). 25-28 Sep rain report lists no new Rasuwa casualties.
body.ne: 1453/5285; 1109 shelter (Rasuwa 805). 25-28 barsa, Rasuwa naya casualty chaina.
body.hi: 1453/5285; 1109 shelter (Rasuwa 805). 25-28 barish, Rasuwa naya casualty nahi.
